data.gender_notes: Sivasankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sivasankar is a compound of two words. Siva refers to Lord Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism. Sankar means the one who bestows grace. Thus, Sivasankar means Lord Shiva's Grace. The name Sivasankar carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Sivasankar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sivasankar is a spiritual name that invokes the blessings of Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and creation. It is believed that this name brings wisdom, strength, and protection to the bearer.
data.etymology: Sivasankar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sivasankar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
